kinds.d: A single panel of fabric that rolls up onto a tube at the head of the window.
A fabric blind that folds up into horizontal pleats as it is raised by cords.
A blind of horizontal slats that tilt and lift on cords or tapes.
A blind of vertical vanes hung from a track that rotate and draw to one side.
A blind of crisply pleated fabric that concertinas up or down.
A pleated blind of two or more fabric layers forming insulating cells.
Wide flat fabric panels that slide side to side on a multi-channel track.
A fabric shade gathered up by hand and held by straps or ties, with no roller or cords.

notes: All eight old kinds kept with old sources; blackout and motorised recorded as types where they apply. No models in old data; none added.
